Definition: from G3539; a perception, i.e. purpose, or (by implication) the intellect, disposition, itself:--device, mind, thought.
BiblicalUsage: A thought is a device, a mind, or a purpose — and Paul's letters watch it in all three forms. We are not ignorant of Satan's devices, the minds of Israel are blinded in the reading of the old covenant, the god of this world blinds the minds of unbelievers, and the peace of God keeps our hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mind is the battlefield: Satan schemes in it, the world blinds it, and the peace of God stands guard over it. The god of this world blinds minds, and the peace of God keeps them — the battle is over what I think.
